questionText: Akash travelled 160 Kms in 3 hours. He went some distance at the rate of 60 Km/hr and the rest at 40 Km/hr. How far did he travel at the rate of 40 Km/hr?

questionText: 30 employees of a company working for 6 hours a day completed a task in 7 days. If 36 employees work for 7 hours a day, what time is required to complete the work?

questionText: A man, a woman and a boy can complete a work in 4 days, 6 days and 12 days respectively. How many boys must assist 1 man and 1 woman to complete the job in half of a day?
